gdp_source: FRED GDP, annual mean of quarterly nominal GDP

bank_capital.measure: aggregate CET1 above the 4.5 percent regulatory minimum
bank_capital.source: 2026 DFAST Table 4: CET1 12.8 percent of 12,583.7bn RWA at 2025:Q4; minimum 4.5 percent per 12 CFR 217.10
bank_capital.alt_measure: losses the Federal Reserve found the 32 banks could absorb in the 2026 severely adverse scenario
bank_capital.strict_measure: headroom to the test's PROJECTED MINIMUM CET1 of 11.2 percent, which is what the 708bn actually consumed

mortgage_bank_held.measure: aggregate bank CET1 above the regulatory minimum
mortgage_bank_held.alt_measure: Fed severely adverse first-lien domestic mortgage loss, 2026 DFAST Table 9

mortgage_agency.measure: combined net worth of Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac
mortgage_agency.source: SEC XBRL company facts from the GSEs' own 10-Q filings: Fannie Mae 112.7bn at 2026-03-31 (10-Q); Freddie Mac 77.8bn at 2026-06-30 (10-Q)
mortgage_agency.flag: The GSEs are in conservatorship. Net worth is not loss-absorbing capital of the same kind as bank CET1 and the Treasury senior preferred agreements sit behind it. This is a scale comparison, not a solvency test.

auto_lenders.measure: aggregate bank CET1 above the regulatory minimum
auto_lenders.alt_measure: Fed severely adverse Other consumer loss, which FOLDS auto and student together, 2026 DFAST Table 9
auto_lenders.flag: Auto is not broken out from student loans by the Fed. The book-specific yardstick is therefore shared between the two rows.

card_consumer_lenders.measure: aggregate bank CET1 above the regulatory minimum
card_consumer_lenders.alt_measure: Fed severely adverse credit card loss, 2026 DFAST Table 9

student_loan_holders.measure: aggregate bank CET1 above the regulatory minimum
student_loan_holders.alt_measure: Fed severely adverse Other consumer loss, shared with auto
student_loan_holders.flag: Most outstanding student debt is federally held, not bank held, so the bank capacity denominator understates who actually bears it. The federal holder's capacity is the public budget row.

business_credit.measure: aggregate bank CET1 above the regulatory minimum
business_credit.alt_measure: Fed severely adverse commercial and industrial loss

commercial_real_estate.measure: aggregate bank CET1 above the regulatory minimum
commercial_real_estate.alt_measure: Fed severely adverse domestic CRE loss

reference_point.note: DERIVED from FRED because CBO publication pages return HTTP 403 to this environment. The exact document is CBO's Preliminary Estimate of the Effects of H.R. 748.

oasdi.reserves_status: BLOCKED. SSA.gov returns HTTP 403 on every route and no FRED series carries the trust fund balance. The exact document is the annual OASDI Trustees Report summary tables. Left empty rather than guessed.

reference_point.note: the combined deficit already being run, A32

hi.measure: annual HI payroll income at the statutory combined rate
hi.source: 2.9 percent (26 USC 3101(b) and 3111(b)) on the uncapped wage bill of 9,870bn

landlords_multifamily.measure: NOT a dollar capacity. Arrears share that breaches debt service coverage, 1 - 1/D
landlords_multifamily.source: FLAGGED. The agency minimum could not be read: Fannie Form 4660 sits behind DUS Navigate and the Freddie Multifamily Guide is a JavaScript application. The range 1.20 to 1.35 is carried as a flagged proxy.
